Before submitting:

- Search existing issues first. Add information to an existing issue if it covers the same problem.
- Keep each issue focused on one problem or feature request. Open a separate issue for unrelated requests and link related issues.
- After testing a released fix, please reply with the result. If the problem is resolved, please close your issue; otherwise, leave it open and describe what still happens.
